Job Description
Parsons is looking for an exceptionally talented Field Engineer - Mechanical to join our site-based Construction Supervision team on a major landmark development project in Riyadh.
The project comprises the design, enabling, and main works for a large-scale destination development featuring several iconic assets, hospitality facilities, and supporting infrastructure. - Monitor and supervise mechanical construction activities to ensure compliance with approved drawings, specifications, contract requirements, and quality standards.

- Ability to identify, analyze, and resolve site-related mechanical issues effectively.

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office and relevant engineering software.

- Experience working on mega projects, landmark developments, hospitality projects, convention centers, airports, or large mixed-use developments.
- Previous experience within a Construction Supervision Consultant (CSC) environment.
- Familiarity with BIM-enabled project delivery processes and model coordination.
- Knowledge of testing, balancing, commissioning, and handover requirements for mechanical systems.
- Experience coordinating with multidisciplinary engineering teams and contractors.
- Strong organizational skills and the ability to work in a fast-paced project environment.

title: Data Center Engineering Operations - 2027 Internship
description:
Description
Want to be part of the team that keeps the world's largest cloud running? As an Engineering Operations Technician Intern at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will get hands-on experience with the critical infrastructure behind Amazon's global data centers — and your work will directly impact millions of customers worldwide.
This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time Engineering Operations Technician position, subject to available roles and business needs.
Who Should Apply
We Welcome Applications From
- Students in the last year of their Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field who are looking for an internship that could lead to a full-time career.
It is a requirement to be graduated by the end of the internship.
About The Role
As an intern, you will provide technical support within Amazon's owned and operated data centers. Your work will ensure that the data center's mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems operate at 100% availability while maintaining first-class customer service to the teams and groups on site.
You will be exposed to both independent work and team-based collaboration. Prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful.
What You Will Do
The Engineering Operations Team Is Amazon's Front-line Responders For Hands-on Electrical And Mechanical Equipment Troubleshooting And Operations. You Will Work With Equipment That Supports Mission-critical Servers And Must Maintain Better Than 99.999% Uptime. This Equipment Includes, But Is Not Limited To
- Stand-by diesel generators and switchgear
- Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPSs) and Power Distribution Units (PDUs)
- Air Handling Units (AHUs), chillers, and cooling towers
- Chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, and Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs)
- Building automation systems
Your Day-to-day Duties Include
- Maintaining mechanical and electrical equipment
- Assisting with root cause analysis of equipment failures
- Troubleshooting facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
- Taking daily operational readings of all mechanical and electrical equipment
- Using internal Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) to manage building workflows
- Interacting with third-party vendors and contractors working on site
Internship Structure
Amazon internships are full-time (40 hours per week) for 3 consecutive months, starting in summer 2027. This position requires the intern to report to work on site daily. Intern schedules are typically day schedules, Sunday through Thursday.
Please note that full-time Engineering Operations Technician roles operate on a rotating shift pattern, which may include days, nights, weekends, and public holidays. Candidates should be willing and able to commit to shift work upon transitioning to a full-time position.
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed below, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, has not followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, do not let that stop you from applying.
Your Career at Amazon — A Universe of Opportunity
At Amazon, your career is not a straight path. It is a journey you build as you go.
From your first day as an intern, you will own real work that matters. You will troubleshoot and maintain the systems that keep AWS running for millions of customers. Your mentors and teammates will champion your growth, helping you build skills you did not know existed — and you will see your work come to life at massive scale.
Impact. Your work shapes the infrastructure that millions of customers rely on every day. From cloud computing to artificial intelligence, the systems you maintain power it all.
Action. You will move fast, experiment, and learn by doing. Your ideas do not get stuck in approval chains — they get tested, refined, and put into practice.
Curiosity. Every project teaches you something new. You will apply what you learned in the classroom to real challenges and explore different teams, technologies, and career paths within Amazon.
Mentorship and career growth. You will start with structured onboarding and get paired with experienced mentors. Beyond that, you will find continuous learning opportunities and the chance to work on different projects. Your journey here is yours to shape.
About The Team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We are the people who keep the cloud running. title: Data Center Technician - 2027 Internship
description:
Description
At Amazon Web Services (AWS), we are working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. Are you ready to embrace the challenge? Come build the future with us.
This is a unique opportunity to work in some of the most cutting-edge data centers in the world. Amazon data centers are large-scale, high-density facilities where you will help change the face of cloud technology in the region — and your work will directly impact millions of customers.
This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time Data Center Technician position, subject to available roles and business needs.
Who Should Apply
We Welcome Applications From
- Students in the last year of their Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical field such as Information Technology, Computer Hardware Repair, or similar. It is a requirement to be graduated by the end of the internship.
Important — Site Location & Commuting: This role is based at a data center facility in a remote location with no public transportation access. A valid driving license and access to personal transportation are required to commute to the site daily. Please consider this before applying.
As a Data Center Technician Intern, you will work as part of the Operations team, whose primary responsibility is the maintenance and upkeep of the data center infrastructure. This position involves hardware and network diagnostics followed by physical repair.
You will be exposed to both independent work and team-based collaboration. Prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful.
What You Will Do
You will provide our internal teams with infrastructure-related support, resolving tickets related to hardware (motherboards, Random Access Memory, Central Processing Units, Graphics Processing Units, and more) and networking (link-down events, optics replacements, switch replacements, and more).
In addition to hardware and network repair, you will learn how to install equipment, create documentation, innovate solutions, and fix complex problems within the data center environment.
Your Day-to-day Duties Include
- Troubleshooting server hardware alongside experienced AWS technicians
- Meeting Service Level Agreements (SLAs) against assigned trouble tickets
- Shadowing AWS technicians during network troubleshooting to build your diagnostic skills
- Replacing media (Solid State Drives and Hard Disk Drives) in accordance with AWS Data Tech guidance
- Performing regular server hardware repairs (drives, motherboards, and other components) under the guidance of experienced technicians
- Interacting with third-party vendors and contractors working on site
Internship Structure
Amazon internships are full-time (40 hours per week) for 3 consecutive months, starting in summer 2027. This position requires the intern to report to work on site daily. Intern schedules are typically day schedules, Sunday through Thursday.
Please note that a full-time Data Center Technician position could involve day, evening, or weekend shifts and on-call rotations. Candidates should be willing and able to commit to shift work upon transitioning to a full-time position.
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed below, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, has not followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, do not let that stop you from applying.
Your Career at Amazon — A Universe of Opportunity
At Amazon, your career is not a straight path. It is a journey you build as you go.
From your first day as an intern, you will own real work that matters. You will diagnose and repair the servers and networks that keep AWS running for millions of customers. Your mentors and teammates will champion your growth, helping you build skills you did not know existed — and you will see your work come to life at massive scale.
Impact. Your work shapes the infrastructure that millions of customers rely on every day. Every server you repair and every network issue you resolve keeps the cloud running.
Action. You will move fast, learn by doing, and solve real problems from day one. Your ideas do not get stuck in approval chains — they get tested, refined, and put into practice.
Curiosity. Every project teaches you something new. You will apply what you learned in the classroom to real challenges and explore different teams, technologies, and career paths within Amazon.
Mentorship and career growth. You will start with structured onboarding and get paired with experienced mentors. Our team is dedicated to supporting new members in an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing. Projects and tasks are assigned in a way that leverages your strengths and helps you further develop your skill set. Your journey here is yours to shape.
About The Team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We are the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on.
You will join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. ROLE PURPOSE
The aim is to state the overall significance of the job from the organization’s perspective.
The Monitoring Operations Center Engineer is responsible for continuously monitoring the health, availability and performance of IT production infrastructure, applications and digital services. The role serves as the first operational point for identifying alerts and service degradation, performing initial investigation and validation, creating or tracking incidents, escalating issues to the appropriate technical teams, and following incidents through resolution in accordance with agreed service-level agreements (SLAs).
Key Accountabilities & Activities
This section describes the principal outputs required from the job.
Key Accountabilities
Key Activities
- Monitoring & Event Management
- Continuously monitor production infrastructure, applications, networks, URLs and critical digital services.
- Monitor dashboards, events, alerts and service-health indicators.
- Identify service degradation, availability issues and abnormal conditions.
- Validate alerts before escalation and distinguish actionable events from false or noisy alerts.
- Monitor CPU, memory, disk, network connectivity, service status, application performance and logs.
- Incident Management
- Perform first-level analysis of monitoring alerts.
- Create or validate incidents generated through monitoring systems.
- Assign and escalate incidents to the appropriate L2/L3 support teams.
- Track incidents until service restoration and closure.
- Follow up with resolver teams and provide regular operational updates.
- Ensure incidents are handled according to defined SLA and escalation procedures.
- Initial Troubleshooting
- Perform basic technical investigation before escalating an incident.
- Review monitoring metrics, logs, event details and service status.
- Check infrastructure resource utilization and connectivity.
- Correlate related alerts where possible.
- Collect relevant evidence, including timestamps, affected components, error messages, graphs and logs, for resolver teams.
- Infrastructure & Application Monitoring
- Monitor servers, operating systems and infrastructure utilization.
- Monitor network devices and connectivity.
- Monitor application availability and performance.
- Monitor application and system logs.
- Monitor URLs and external service availability.
- Support end-to-end visibility of business-critical services.
- Alert Handling & Escalation
- Prioritize alerts according to severity and business or service impact.
- Follow the defined notification and escalation matrix.
- Ensure critical alerts receive immediate attention.
- Escalate unresolved or recurring issues appropriately.
- Reduce unnecessary escalation by conducting proper L1 validation.
- Operational Communication & Shift Handover
- Maintain clear incident notes and operational records.
- Communicate significant alerts and incidents to relevant support teams.
- Provide accurate handover of open incidents, ongoing issues and critical observations between shifts.
- Escalate major production-impacting conditions promptly.
- Reporting & Continuous Improvement
- Support the preparation of daily and shift operational reports.
- Identify recurring alarms and monitoring gaps.
- Report false-positive or noisy alerts for tuning.
- Participate in incident reviews when required.
- Suggest improvements to dashboards, alerts and operational procedures.
- Policies, Processes & Procedures
- Follow all relevant departmental policies, processes, standard operating procedures, and instructions so that work is carried out in a controlled and consistent manner.
- Comply with all relevant safety, quality, and environmental management policies, procedures, and controls to ensure a healthy and safe work environment.
- Information Security

Academic And Professional Qualifications

Job Description
As a Commissioning Engineer, you will be responsible for planning, executing, and overseeing the commissioning of the Sewage Treatment Plant (STP) and TSE pipeline to ensure that all systems and processes operate safely, efficiently, and in full compliance with design specifications, contractual requirements, and applicable regulatory standards. The role requires close coordination with design, construction, mechanical, electrical, and instrumentation teams, as well as effective engagement with project stakeholders.
In your capacity as a Commissioning Engineer, you will lead pre commissioning and commissioning activities, including inspections, testing, start up, performance trials, and final handover of the STP. You will ensure that treatment processes consistently achieve the required effluent quality and that full operational readiness is established prior to final acceptance. Additionally, you will be responsible for achieving timely completion of project milestones within the approved budget and for providing regular progress updates to relevant stakeholders.
Responsibilities
General:
- Plan and manage pre‑commissioning, commissioning, and start‑up activities for STP systems and TSE pipeline.
- Supervise EPC Contractor’s team during process commissioning of the complete sewage treatment plant.
- Oversee and verify installation completion and readiness of civil, mechanical, electrical, and I&C systems.
- Coordinate testing of equipment such as pumps, blowers, screens, clarifiers, biological reactors (Nereda), filters, disinfection systems, sludge systems and odour control systems and TSE pipeline.
- Lead process commissioning, including biological (Nereda based) seeding, stabilization, and optimization.
- Monitor plant performance to ensure treated effluent meets statutory and contract requirements.
- Review commissioning procedures, method statements, and test protocols.
- Troubleshoot operational and process issues during start‑up and trial runs.
- Coordinate with EPC Contractor and OEMs for equipment commissioning and performance testing.
- Oversee compliance with HSE requirements during commissioning activities.
- Prepare/Review and submit commissioning reports, performance test results, and handover documentation.
- Support training of client’s operations and maintenance (O&M) staff.
- Assist in final acceptance, defect liability support, and transition to O&M phase.
- Collaborate with project stakeholders and share progress report regularly
- Ensure the timely completion of commissioning milestones within the allocated budget.
- Regularly report on project progress to the relevant stakeholders.
Team Leadership:
- Supervise the EPC Contractor’s site team during commissioning.
- Participate in site meetings, and other project-related meetings as required.
- Offer guidance, training, and mentorship.
- Cultivate a culture of safety and professionalism within the team.
Quality Assurance:
- Establish and maintain robust quality control procedures for commissioning work.
- Ensure adherence of Project Quality standard during commissioning phase
Safety and Compliance:
- Ensure that commissioning activities are executed in a safe and efficient manner.
- Ensure adherence of Safety regulations/compliance during testing and commissioning
- Investigate and report any safety incidents or near misses.
Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Environmental, Chemical, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline.
- Proven experience in STP / wastewater treatment plant commissioning and startup; strong experience in commissioning Nereda® SBR systems will be considered a significant advantage.
- > 10 years of relevant experience in process, mechanical, instrumentation, or commissioning roles, with a primary focus on wastewater and sewage treatment projects.
- In‑depth knowledge of local environmental regulations, discharge standards, and statutory compliance requirements.

عند الانضمام إلى فندق الريتز كارلتون، فإنك تنضم إلى مجموعة من العلامات التجارية مع ماريوت الدولية. كن في المكان الذي يمكنك فيه القيام بأفضل أعمالك، وابدأ هدفك، وانتمي إلى فريق عالمي مذهل، لتصبح أفضل نسخة منك.

- Recognise when to loop in Product, Solutions Architecture or Engineering, and ensure a smooth handoff.
- Bring client and competitor insights back to Product to keep our positioning sharp.
What We’re Looking For
Essential Requirements
- 3–5 years of experience in sales engineering, solutions engineering or technical pre-sales, preferably in fintech or B2B SaaS.
- Deep hands-on knowledge of APIs, JSON, integration patterns and system architecture — comfortable going technical with any engineering team.

- Background as a software engineer or developer.
- Experience in banking, payments or open banking.
- Familiarity with RFPs/RFIs and enterprise technical workshops.
- An international mindset and ease working across different cultures and markets.
Soft Skills That Make a Difference
- Collaborative mindset and team spirit.
- Proactivity and problem-solving attitude.
- Curiosity and adaptability.
- Clear and confident communication.
- Strong sense of ownership and accountability.

- Real impact on global fintech transformation projects.
- Continuous growth and learning opportunities within a fast-evolving and innovative group.
Our Hiring Process
- Intro chat with HR – to get to know each other.
- Technical interview with our team – to explore your engineering background, skills and approach.
- Conversation with our Sales team – to assess your commercial mindset and alignment with the role.
- Final feedback – transparent, timely, and respectful.
Every hiring process is a chance for mutual learning and growth.
Our Culture

title: Application Engineer - MENA
description:
About EnerVenue
EnerVenue is a Silicon Valley-based energy infrastructure company commercializing metal-hydrogen battery technology originally developed by NASA for the Hubble Space Telescope and the International Space Station. Founded in 2020 by Stanford Professor Yi Cui, EnerVenue adapts this proven aerospace chemistry for grid-scale terrestrial energy storage, delivering batteries with 30,000+ cycle lifetimes, inherent fire-safety, and a 30-year design life.
In 2026, EnerVenue closed a $300 million Series B extension and is well capitalized for growth. Funds are being deployed to build a high-volume manufacturing facility in Changzhou, China, targeting 250 MWh capacity by Q3 2026 and 1 GWh by 2027. EnerVenue has been named one of Time magazine's Top 10 US Green Technology Companies of 2025.
The Role
We are seeking a technically rigorous and customer-focused Energy Storage Applications Engineer to bridge the gap between our advanced energy storage technology and real-world deployment. This is a strategic, hands-on role critical to our mission. You will translate customer requirements into optimized system designs, validate performance across diverse use cases, and ensure our solutions deliver measurable value in the field. Acting as the technical backbone of the commercial process, you will support sales, marketing, product, and engineering teams with modeling, integration guidance, technical sales support, and application expertise.
This role covers EnerVenue's Middle East region and is based remotely in Saudi Arabia, working directly with utilities, developers, EPC contractors and industrial customers across the Kingdom and the wider GCC.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the Technical Pre-Sales Process:
Serve as the primary technical partner to Sales throughout the commercial lifecycle—from initial qualification through contract execution. Shape deal strategy by translating customer use cases, financial objectives, and operating constraints into technically optimized, commercially compelling storage solutions.
Translate Market Opportunities Into Bankable Proposals
- Lead technical discovery sessions to define duty cycles, performance guarantees, augmentation strategies, and integration requirements.
- Develop robust energy storage models that quantify lifetime performance, degradation, efficiency, availability, and ROI.
- Produce detailed technical proposals and bid packages, including system sizing, single-line diagrams, performance assumptions, and compliance documentation.
Strengthen Technical Sales Enablement
- Partner with Sales to respond to RFPs, RFIs, and technical due diligence requests with speed, accuracy, and credibility.
- Support customer meetings, executive presentations, and contract negotiations as the technical authority.
- Develop standardized tools, calculators, and modeling frameworks that improve proposal consistency, cycle time, and win rates.
- Manage customer facing technical documentation and work alongside technical teams to generate documentation as necessary for project proposals.
- Develop and/or review System designs, Single Lines, Layouts, Containerization, Performance guarantees, Availability guarantees, etc.
Amplify Marketing & Market Positioning
- Collaborate with Marketing to develop application notes, white papers, case studies, and technical content that articulate differentiated value.
- Translate complex engineering advantages into clear, benefit-driven messaging for target segments (utility-scale, C&I, microgrid).
- Provide technical input for product launches, webinars, conference presentations, and thought leadership initiatives.
Accelerate Cross-Functional Alignment
- Serve as a bridge from the Commercial team to Product and Engineering, ensuring customer requirements and emerging use cases inform the roadmap.
- Support commissioning readiness and early deployment to protect performance assumptions made during the sales process.
Position Requirements
The ideal candidate likely spent the first part of his or her career building deep technical foundations in power systems, battery engineering, PV + storage integration, or grid-connected infrastructure—either at a leading OEM, EPC, developer, utility, or technology-driven energy company—where he or she developed rigorous analytical skills and a strong safety mindset. He or she has since operated in a fast-paced, customer-facing or scaling environment, applying that technical depth to commercial pursuits and supporting projects from early-stage feasibility through commissioning and field optimization.
- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, Energy Systems, or a related technical discipline.
- 5+ years of progressive experience in Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), including system design, applications engineering, integration, technical sales support, and service.
- Demonstrated expertise designing multi-MW scale energy storage systems, with strong command of both DC and AC electrical design principles.
- High level of technical aptitude spanning from battery cell fundamentals through C&I and utility-scale battery systems.
- Strong working knowledge of secondary battery chemistries, degradation mechanisms, system architectures, and operational limitations across diverse duty cycles.
- Practical experience with balance-of-system (BOS) equipment, including inverters, medium-voltage transformers, combiner boxes, DC/DC converters, EMS, and BMS platforms.
- Strong knowledge of NEC and applicable regulatory codes and standards for PV and energy storage installations, including NFPA 70 (NEC), IEEE 1547, UL 9540, UL 1741, and other relevant global standards.
- Working knowledge of grid connection and product compliance requirements applicable in Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC, including Saudi Electricity Company grid connection requirements and SASO / GSO conformity schemes.
- Solid understanding of how energy storage and PV projects are constructed, commissioned, and brought online.
- Experience specifying or validating energy storage equipment for high-ambient-temperature environments.
- Ability to interpret operational data, apply statistical analysis techniques, and produce clear, actionable reports.
- Working knowledge of commercial contracts, performance guarantees, and how technical design and proposal assumptions must support contractual obligations.
- Familiarity with competitive energy storage products in the market and the ability to clearly articulate differentiated technical value.
- Proven ability to operate cross-functionally across engineering, product, sales, marketing, and field teams.
- Demonstrated ability to meet tight deadlines, manage multiple priorities, and maintain accountability for deliverables.
- Professional fluency in Arabic and English, written and spoken, with the ability to run technical discussions and present to customers in both languages.
- Based in Saudi Arabia and working remotely, with the right to work in the Kingdom.
- Willingness and ability to travel 10–20% to support customer engagement, project development, site validation, and industry events.
Mandatory Core Competencies
- Technical Depth & Range:
You are equally comfortable discussing electrochemical behavior at the cell level and reviewing single-line diagrams for multi-MW grid-connected systems. You can move seamlessly between modeling software and a job site.
- Pre-Sales & Commercial Orientation:
You understand that technical precision underpins revenue. Your expertise turns technical jargon into marketing differentiation. You support proposals that stand up to RFP scrutiny, independent engineer review, and contractual performance guarantees.
- Professional & Accountable:
You meet commitments, communicate proactively, and maintain composure and clarity under tight timelines and high-stakes customer interactions.
Ideal Mindset & Competencies
- Bridge Builder (Between Engineering and Revenue):
They see themselves as a strategic enabler of growth. Their technical clarity accelerates deal cycles, increases win rates, and strengthens customer confidence.
- Application-First Thinker:
They design around real operating profiles—capacity firming, arbitrage, peak shaving, resilience, grid services—ensuring systems are optimized for performance and economics. They are also a code master, ensuring all stakeholders are aligned with NEC, IEEE, UL, and applicable global standards.
- Commercially Fluent Engineer:
They understand contracts, guarantees, liquidated damages risk, and bankability requirements—and ensure technical proposals align with those realities.
- Market-Aware Technologist:
They track competitor capabilities and industry standards closely, positioning EnerVenue’s technology with precision and credibility.
- Disciplined Under Pressure:
They thrive under deadlines, balancing technical thoroughness with commercial urgency, and consistently deliver high-quality work on schedule.
- Forward-Thinking & Creative:
They anticipate evolving grid needs, emerging use cases, and new commercial models—bringing fresh thinking to how energy storage is designed, positioned, and deployed.
What EnerVenue Offers
- Unique opportunity to own full end-to-end technical application engineering work of a disruptive long-duration metal-hydrogen energy storage technology in the Middle East, the company’s key strategic growth market
- Direct alignment with EnerVenue’s manufacturing team and joint technical roadmap planning with product engineering team
- Competitive compensation package for mid-level technical leadership role including base salary and project performance bonus tied to successful bid delivery and project win rate
- Mid-level technical management position backed by top-tier global investors, with clear gigawatt-scale production capacity expansion roadmap based out of Changzhou, China to fully support Middle East market supply
- Join a mission-driven team developing 30-year service-life grid infrastructure energy storage equipment
- Full technical training resources, access to global electrochemical R&D data and field test cases, plus funding for regional industry conferences and standard certification upgrades

title: Onsite Engineer (MEP)
description:
Job Description – Onsite Engineer (MEP)
Location: Hail, Farm Site, Saudi Arabia
Job Purpose
To ensure uninterrupted power supply and reliable operation of all electrical and MEP systems across the farm. The role is responsible for managing the main electricity supply, diesel generators, electrical equipment, preventive and corrective maintenance, energy optimization, and compliance with electrical safety standards.
Key Responsibilities
A. Power Supply Management
- Monitor and manage the main electricity supply and ensure uninterrupted power distribution.
- Oversee DG generator operation and power switchover during outages.
- Monitor electricity consumption and identify opportunities for energy optimization.
- Maintain fuel consumption records and ensure timely refueling.
B. Diesel Generator Operations
- Conduct daily inspections of DG sets, including oil, coolant, filters, belts, and overall performance.
- Perform scheduled preventive maintenance and coordinate major repairs with OEMs.
- Troubleshoot generator breakdowns and maintain operational records.
- Monitor generator runtime, fuel consumption, and maintenance costs.
C. Electrical & MEP Equipment Maintenance
- Supervise installation, operation, and maintenance of electrical systems and equipment.
- Maintain electrical motors, water pumps, HVAC systems, cold storage, and lighting systems.
- Monitor electrical panels, switchgear, irrigation systems, RO plants, and automation equipment.
- Conduct preventive maintenance and ensure timely resolution of electrical and MEP breakdowns.
D. Safety & Compliance
- Ensure electrical installations comply with applicable electrical codes and safety standards.
- Implement Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures during maintenance activities.
- Conduct regular electrical safety inspections and maintain earthing and insulation resistance records.
- Ensure safe working practices for all maintenance personnel.
E. Documentation & Reporting
- Maintain daily electrical and DG operational logbooks.
- Prepare monthly power consumption and maintenance reports.
- Maintain inventory of electrical spare parts, tools, and consumables.
- Develop and implement SOPs for electrical and MEP operations.
Soft Skills:
Strong problem-solving ability. Self-motivated and reliable for remote operations. Good communication for reporting and coordination. Teamwork and ability to guide support staff
Work Conditions:
Onsite stay at the farm is mandatory (housing provided). Must be available 24/7 for emergency breakdowns. Work includes both indoor and outdoor activities in varying weather conditions.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
Uptime of electrical systems (%). DG maintenance cost per hour. Preventive vs breakdown maintenance ratio. Energy consumption per operational output (e.g., per acre or per production unit). Safety incident rate.
Minimum Requirements
- Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering / Electrical & Electronics Engineering.
- 5–8 years of experience in electrical maintenance, MEP operations, or industrial facilities.
- Hands-on experience with diesel generators and electrical distribution systems.
- Experience maintaining pumps, motors, HVAC, and industrial electrical equipment.
- Experience in farms, poultry facilities, agriculture, or remote industrial sites is preferred.

- Infrastructure & Automation: Design, develop, and automate infrastructure using Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) principles. Maintain robust CI/CD pipelines using GitLab.

- System Reliability: Take ownership of production systems with a "you build it, you run it" mindset. Manage real-time system monitoring, observability, and incident response to meet strict SLA commitments.

Job Skills & Qualifications
- Education: Degree in Computer Science or a related discipline. 
- Experience: 4+ years in systems administration, solutions delivery, or integration engineering. Experience with support & operations of highly critical productions systems and Understanding of ITSM processes (incident, Change, Problem, SLA's...) required.
- Cloud & Orchestration: Advance experience in public cloud (preferably GCP), Kubernetes, and container orchestration along with GitLab, CI/ID, Vaults.
- Automation & Scripting: Autonomous in Bash, Python, or Perl. Experience with Terraform, Helm.
- Advanced Linux experience (minimum 3 years).
- Strong understanding of networking (IPv4, Subnetting, TCP/IP, packet routing).
- Deep knowledge of HTTP(S), SOAP, and REST APIs.
- Strong proficiency in Apache, SSL/TLS/mTLS.
- Databases: Hands-on experience in Cassandra and MySQL. 
- Telecom Domain (Preferred): Experience with eSIM technologies (e.g., SGP22/32) and telecommunications infrastructure. 
- Development: A background in Java is highly preferred.
Behavior Competencies
- Mindset: Customer-oriented, self-starter, analytical, and an excellent team player. 
- Communication: Strong communicator capable of managing conflicts in a fast-paced environment. 
- Adaptability: Quick learner, flexible with hours, and ready to participate onsite in 24/7 team support to ensure system resilience.

The individual supports the delivery of a facility and its supporting infrastructure, systems, and processes that are fully prepared for safe, efficient, and sustainable operations from day one. The role focuses on executing the operational readiness program in collaboration with engineering, supply chain, construction, commissioning, and operations and maintenance (O&M) teams.
The Operational Readiness Engineer ensures that readiness plans, procedures, training, and documentation are effectively implemented, verified, and transitioned to operations. The position provides technical expertise, coordination, and hands-on support to bridge the gap between project delivery and operational functionality.
The Operational Readiness Engineer contributes to ensuring that systems, processes, and personnel are technically and procedurally prepared to support safe and reliable operations upon handover. This includes integrating asset readiness and maintainability principles throughout project execution, from detailed design to commissioning and start-up.
Key Responsibilities Include
- Operational Readiness Plan (ORP) Implementation:
Execute and maintain elements of the Operational Readiness Plan under the direction of the Operational Readiness Manager. Track progress against readiness gates and support readiness reviews.
- Asset Information and Data Integration:
Support the definition and population of asset hierarchies, criticality assessments, and metadata requirements. Assist in validating asset information within the Asset Information Model (AIM) and CMMS to ensure alignment with ISO 55001 standards.
- Maintenance and Reliability Preparation:
Work with maintenance and reliability teams to verify that maintainability requirements are incorporated into system designs. Assist in developing and uploading preventive and predictive maintenance tasks into the CMMS.
- Spare Parts and Materials Coordination:
Support the identification and cataloguing of long-lead items, initial spares, and consumables. Coordinate with supply chain and warehouse teams to ensure proper storage, tagging, and data entry.
- Procedure and Documentation Support:

title: Commissioning Engineer

description:
Position Overview
The Commissioning Engineer is responsible for planning, coordinating, executing, and supervising all commissioning activities across the project lifecycle for ELV, security systems, electrical, mechanical, or multi-disciplinary packages. The role ensures that systems are tested, validated, and handed over in accordance with project specifications, client standards (Aramco/HCIS/EPC), and operational requirements.
Location: Project-based (KSA) – Candidate must be willing to travel and relocate as required
⸻
Key Responsibilities
1. Commissioning Planning & Strategy
• Develop the overall commissioning plan, procedures, schedules, and resource requirements.
• Define system boundaries, commissioning stages, and ITPs in alignment with project specifications.
• Coordinate with engineering, procurement, construction, and QA/QC teams to ensure readiness.
2. Pre-Commissioning Activities
• Review IFC drawings, shop drawings, vendor documentation, FAT reports, and method statements.
• Verify installation completion through inspections, punch lists, and readiness checklists.
• Ensure proper calibration, configuration, and connectivity of devices before functional testing.
3. System Commissioning & Testing
• Lead implementation of commissioning tests such as functionality, integration, performance, and reliability tests.
• Supervise commissioning technicians and subcontractors to ensure proper execution.
• Conduct system integration testing for ELV/ICT/security systems (CCTV, ACS, IDS, PA, Structured Cabling, Network Systems).
• Review and validate test results and logs and ensure compliance with standards.
4. Client Coordination & Approvals
• Interface with client representatives (Aramco PMT, HCIS, EPC, Consultant) for inspections, approvals, and sign-offs.
• Lead SAT (Site Acceptance Test) and demonstrate system functionalities.
• Coordinate with stakeholders to close NCRs, punch points, and ensure system acceptance.
5. Documentation & Reporting
• Prepare commissioning dossiers, test reports, checklists, red-line/as-built inputs, and turnover packages.
• Maintain daily commissioning logs, progress trackers, and compliance reports.
• Ensure documentation aligns with Aramco, HCIS, or project-specific templates and requirements.
6. Handover & Post-Commissioning Support
• Achieve mechanical completion (MC), pre-commissioning, commissioning, and final acceptance milestones.
• Support training for end-users and O&M teams.
• Assist in system optimization, troubleshooting, and warranty-related activities post-handover.
Qualifications & Skills
Educational Requirements
• Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics/Communication Engineering, Instrumentation, or related discipline.
Experience Requirements
• 5-7 years of experience in commissioning activities for ELV, ICT, security systems, electrical, or industrial projects.
• Experience with Aramco/HCIS/SABIC/NEOM projects is preferred.
• Prior exposure to commissioning large-scale integrated security systems is an added advantage.
Technical Competencies
• Strong knowledge of commissioning methodologies, testing tools, and system integration practices.
• Expertise in ELV/security systems: CCTV, ACS, F&G, Radar/Perimeter Systems, Network/Switching, Structured Cabling, Servers, Storage, and BMS/SCADA interfaces.
• Ability to read and interpret drawings, schematics, network layouts, ITPs, and method statements.
• Familiarity with Aramco SAT, HCIS compliance requirements, and project commissioning standards.
Soft Skills
• Strong leadership and team supervision capabilities.
• Excellent communication with client, consultant, and internal teams.
• Ability to manage high-pressure timelines and resolve technical issues proactively.
• Detailed, disciplined, and methodical approach to testing and documentation.
Key Deliverables
• Commissioning Plan & Schedule
• Commissioning Test Procedures (CTPs)
• Checklists & Test Sheets
• Pre-Commissioning/Commissioning Reports
• SAT Reports & Client Sign-Offs
• As-Built/Redline Inputs
• Final Handover Package

title: Aluminium Profile & Systems Design Engineer

description:
About the role
MAO is building extrusion capacity that does not yet exist in the Middle East, including four 50 MN 12-inch presses for large industrial sections. This role turns customer needs into profiles and systems that can be extruded, fabricated and certified here, and sold as Made in Saudi.
You will own the design of a profile from first sketch to approved die drawing and production sample. You will also design complete systems, where several profiles, connectors, fasteners and accessories work together as one product.
Target applications include structural and industrial sections, offshore helidecks, truck and trailer sidewalls, large cable trays, solar mounting, marine sections, tent and shelter frames, oil and gas sections, heat sinks, and architectural fins and mullions.
Key responsibilities
Profile design
- Design new extrusion profiles from customer drawings, samples or functional briefs, in 6xxx alloys (6060, 6063, 6005A, 6061, 6082) and others where needed.
- Optimise sections for extrudability: wall thickness ratios, tongue ratios, hollow and semi-hollow features, circumscribing circle diameter and press size.
- Minimise weight per metre while meeting strength, stiffness and functional targets.
- Specify tolerances to EN 755-9 / EN 12020 or ASTM B221 / ANSI H35.2, and surface requirements for anodising or powder coating.
- Produce release drawings and work with the die shop and die makers on die design, die trials and corrections.
System design
- Design complete systems: profiles, joints, connectors, fixings, gaskets and accessories that assemble into a working product.
- Develop industrial systems such as structural frames, platforms, cable management, solar structures and modular framing.
- Design for fabrication and assembly: machining, CNC, bending, welding and bolted connections.
- Build system catalogues, technical data sheets and installation guidance.
Structural engineering
- Calculate section properties (area, Ixx, Iyy, Zx, Zy, J) and check members to Eurocode 9 (EN 1999), the Aluminum Design Manual or equivalent.
- Run FEA on critical profiles and connections, including deflection, buckling, fatigue and thermal effects.
- Account for heat-affected zone strength loss in welded designs.
- Support third-party certification and testing for structural and offshore products.
Customer and commercial support
- Work with sales on technical enquiries, feasibility and cost-driven redesign (value engineering).
- Meet customers to understand application, loads and installation conditions.
- Advise on alloy, temper and finish for each application.
Engineering management
- Maintain the profile library, drawing numbers, revisions and die register.
- Set up design standards and checklists for the engineering team.
- Train junior designers and draughtsmen as the team grows.
Requirements
Education
- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Structural, Civil or Materials Engineering.
Experience
- 8+ years designing aluminium extrusion profiles, with at least 5 years at an extruder, system house or die maker.
- Proven record of profiles taken from concept to production, with a portfolio of released designs.
- Experience designing complete aluminium systems, not only individual sections.
- Hands-on work with die designers and press teams on die trials and corrections.
Technical knowledge
- Extrusion process: billet, die types (solid, porthole, bridge), press capacity, extrusion ratio, quench and ageing.
- Aluminium alloys and tempers, mechanical properties and their effect on design.
- Profile tolerances and standards: EN 755, EN 12020, ASTM B221, ANSI H35.2.
- Structural design to Eurocode 9 or the Aluminum Design Manual.
- Joining methods: welding (MIG/TIG, friction stir), bolting, clinching, snap-fit and screw ports.
- Surface treatment: anodising, powder coating and their design implications.
Software
- 2D and 3D CAD: AutoCAD plus SolidWorks, Inventor or CATIA.
- FEA: ANSYS, Abaqus, SolidWorks Simulation or similar.
- Section property and structural tools (e.g. RFEM, SAP2000, STAAD, or in-house tools).
Language
- Fluent English, written and spoken. Arabic is an advantage.
Preferred qualifications
- Experience with industrial and structural profiles — large sections from 10–12 inch presses or above, wide flat panels, interlocking deck planks, heavy hollows.
- Design work in one or more of: offshore and helidecks, transport (trailers, rail, truck bodies), marine (5083 / 6061), solar mounting, scaffolding and formwork, temporary structures, defence.
- Designs approved by classification or certification bodies (DNV, ABS, Lloyd's, CAP 437 for helidecks, TÜV).
- Friction stir welding of wide panels from narrow extrusions.
- Master's degree in structural or mechanical engineering, or a chartered/PE status.
- GCC or Saudi experience, and familiarity with Aramco or SASO requirements.

The Project Execution Engineer (HVAC Projects) is based in Riyadh and accountable for the end-to-end delivery of HVAC projects across the Central Region of KSA. This includes chiller replacements, retrofit works, VRV system supply and installation, and full turnkey solutions. The role owns the full project lifecycle from handover by Sales through planning, execution, monitoring & control, financial governance, commissioning, and close-out ensuring delivery is on time, within budget, compliant with contractual obligations, and aligned with quality and HSE standards.

Project Launch & Initiation
- Validate project scope, specifications, commercial terms, and contractual obligations received from Sales.

Planning & Execution

Monitoring & Control
- Track progress against baseline schedules and key milestones.
- Monitor cost performance, variations, and change orders.
- Issue accurate and timely progress reports, dashboards, and forecasts.

Project Financial Oversight
- Own project financial performance including budgeting, forecasting, cost control, and margin protection.
- Manage payments, variations, and claims while ensuring alignment with contractual and profitability targets.
Testing, Commissioning & Handover
- Oversee testing and commissioning of HVAC systems, including chillers and VRV systems.
- Ensure systems meet design intent, operational performance, and client requirements.
- Lead final inspections, snag closure, and stakeholder approvals.
- Ensure complete and accurate handover documentation (as-built drawings, O&M manuals, warranties).
- Secure formal client acceptance and project closure.
Post-Implementation Review
- Conduct structured project close-out reviews focusing on performance, risks, and financial outcomes.
- Capture lessons learned and institutionalized best practices.
- Support service teams during the defect liability period (DLP).
- Strengthen client relationships to enable repeat business and long-term partnerships.

title: Calibration Technician (Saudi Nationals Only)
description:
Location: Dammam, Saudi Arabia - On-site
Reports To: Director Middle East Operations
Who We Are
At UE Systems we believe that every person, regardless of their industry, company size, experience, or budget, should have the tools and support to help their facilities operate more efficiently, reliably, and safely. We do this by providing a portfolio of ultrasound solutions designed to be versatile and simple to use.
Since 1973, we have helped thousands of customers across the world prevent equipment failures, identify energy losses, and return home safe to their families. We are continuing to grow as we build a more disciplined, globally connected operating system to support our customers and our next stage of growth.
About The Role
We are seeking a Saudi National Calibration Technician to support our service operations from our newly established, on-site office in Dammam, Saudi Arabia. In this role, you will calibrate, troubleshoot, repair, and test precision ultrasonic instrumentation, ensuring every product meets UE Systems' quality standards before it is returned to our customers. Your work will directly support our commitment to delivering reliable products and exceptional customer service throughout the Middle East.
This position is ideal for a certified technician who enjoys hands-on technical work, takes pride in delivering accurate, high-quality results, and is committed to providing exceptional customer service. As our dedicated technical resource in Saudi Arabia, you will work with a high degree of independence, managing your own workload, prioritizing competing demands, and ensuring repairs and calibrations are completed efficiently while meeting established quality and service turnaround expectations. The successful candidate is detail-oriented, proactive, organized, and self-motivated, with strong problem-solving, time management, and organizational skills, and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision while consistently delivering an exceptional customer experience.
To support your success, you will travel to UE Systems' headquarters in the Netherlands for approximately two weeks of hands-on technical training at the start of your employment. During this training, you will learn UE Systems' products, calibration procedures, repair techniques, quality standards, and service processes before returning to provide local technical support throughout the Middle East.
As the first Calibration Technician based in our Saudi Arabia office, you will play an important role in expanding UE Systems' regional service capabilities. While working independently on a day-to-day basis, you will be supported by our experienced global service organization and will follow the proven standards, processes, and best practices established across UE Systems.
Our People
They Own Their Day: We do not micro-manage. Our team understands the outcome, makes disciplined decisions, and communicates early when priorities, risks, or constraints change.
They Believe in a Team Approach: No one is expected to be a master of everything. We rely on each other, bring different strengths to the table, and build better systems together.
They Always Look Through a Customer Lens: Every process we build should make it easier to serve the customer accurately, reliably, and on time.
Your Impact 
- Perform calibration, troubleshooting, testing, and repair of UE Systems' precision ultrasonic instrumentation.
- Diagnose faults in analogue and digital printed circuit boards, electronic components, and electro-mechanical assemblies.
- Perform soldering, component replacement, and mechanical assembly/disassembly as required.
- Operate electronic test equipment, including oscilloscopes, digital multimeters, power supplies, and signal generators, to diagnose and verify equipment performance.
- Complete calibrations and repairs in accordance with UE Systems' quality standards, technical procedures, and service documentation.
- Generate and maintain accurate calibration certificates, repair records, and other service documentation.
- Manage assigned repairs and calibrations independently while consistently meeting established quality and service turnaround expectations.
- Coordinate the shipping, receiving, and tracking of customer equipment and repair parts for domestic and international shipments.
- Maintain inventory of repair parts, calibration equipment, tools, and service consumables.
- Ensure the service area, tools, and equipment are maintained in a clean, organized, and safe condition.
- Communicate professionally with customers and internal teams regarding repair status, service updates, and technical questions.
- Represent UE Systems professionally by delivering exceptional technical service and customer support throughout the Middle East.
- Follow all company quality, safety, and operational procedures.
Your Experience
- Recognized technical diploma or vocational qualification in Electronics, Instrumentation, Electrical Technology, Mechatronics, or a related technical field.
- 3+ years of hands-on experience repairing, testing, calibrating, or servicing electronic or electro-mechanical equipment
- Understanding of analogue and digital printed circuit boards, electronic components, and mechanical assemblies.
- Ability to troubleshoot, repair, and solder electronic or electro-mechanical equipment.
- Ability to read and interpret electronic schematics and technical drawings.
- Experience operating electronic test equipment, including oscilloscopes, digital multimeters, power supplies, and signal generators.
- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
- Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications. 
- Saudi Nationality Required: Applicants must be Saudi nationals to be eligible for this position.
Nice to Have 
- Experience working within a manufacturing, technical service, or international business environment.
- Experience coordinating domestic and international shipping and receiving.
- Experience working with a CRM (HubSpot preferred) and/or ERP or inventory management system.
- Familiarity with ISO/IEC 17025-style calibration documentation, traceability, and calibration lab practices
Why Join Us? 
We are in the process of radically transforming our business in a way that will redefine our company and our place in the market, making this one of the most exciting times in UE Systems history. There is more opportunity than ever before for our people as we expand our business to become a world-class purpose-driven, digitally-led ultrasound solution provider and we need your help to achieve this.

industry: Construction, Building Construction, and Engineering Services
description:

This prestigious heritage project in Riyadh is part of Saudi Arabia’s Vision 2030 initiative and targets Gold LEED certification. The development includes mixed-use buildings, academies, a traditional Najdi-style local mosque, a digital art museum, and a unique mud-brick cinema with underground parking. This project combines state-of-the-art facilities with traditional design elements, embodying cultural authenticity and modern sustainability goals.
Job Summary:
 As an Acoustic Engineer, you shall be responsible for ensuring that a building or infrastructure project meets all relevant noise and vibration regulations and design specifications. You will act as an expert advisor to CSC and contractors throughout the project construction lifecycle, and post-construction. A good working knowledge of acoustic materials for reverberation control and detailing of construction elements (particularly partitions, ceilings, mullions etc.) will be beneficial.
This role involves ensuring all Contractor’s submittals comply with relevant international and local codes and standards while collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to integrate Acoustics systems requirements are met into the building’s overall design/ construction. 
Key Responsibilities
The key duties of an Acoustics Engineer in this role are varied and combine technical expertise with practical, on-site application: 
- Review architectural, structural, and mechanical drawings & technical submittals, providing expert input on materials, layouts, and construction methods to achieve optimal acoustic performance.
- Conduct environmental and occupational noise surveys using specialized equipment to measure baseline sound and vibration levels in and around the construction site.
- Undertake noise & vibration impact assessments to make sure they meet building regulations and relevant local and international codes.
- Measure vibrations from sources like traffic, machinery, or footsteps, and design solutions to mitigate their effects on the structure and occupants.
- Use advanced computer modeling software (e.g., CadnaA, ODEON) to predict sound propagation and simulate room acoustics, helping to design soundproofing and control reverberation.
- Advise on noise control for building services like HVAC systems to prevent noise from interfering with quiet spaces.
- Conduct site visits and inspections to ensure that the acoustic design solutions are implemented correctly by contractors.
- Supervise the installation of acoustic materials and systems, and address any on-site issues or deviations from the design.
- Perform post-construction (commissioning) testing to verify that the final build meets the specified acoustic performance criteria and building regulations.
- Prepare/ review detailed technical reports (as required), proposals, and presentations that clearly communicate complex findings and recommendations to client, project manager, and other stakeholders, often explaining technical issues to non-experts.
- Liaise with clients, architects, and other disciplines to ensure an integrated design approach. 
- Provide mentorship and guidance to junior engineers on fire safety design best practices and code compliance.
Requirements
- A bachelor's degree in acoustics, or a relevant engineering discipline (mechanical, civil, environmental), any specialist qualification in Acoustics and noise Control shall be preferred
- Minimum 10+ years of experience in the relevant role / position, experience in Consultancy / CSC companies preferred
- Proficiency in sound measurement tools, noise modeling software, data analysis, and an understanding of relevant codes of practice and legislation.
- Strong problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, excellent written and verbal communication skills, and the capacity to work both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
- Membership in professional bodies like the Institute of Acoustics (IOA) can enhance credibility and career prospects. Valid membership of Saudi Council of Engineers is required.
- Familiarity with AutoCAD/BIM, and Microsoft application suite.
- Excellent oral communication skills in English
- Ability to work both independently and in a team atmosphere.
- Ability to meet deadlines under pressure.
- Ability to work in a very dynamic and demanding work environment.
- Ability to work independently with minimal oversight.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills are essential for effective coordination and reporting. 
- Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary team environment

Immediate

title: HSE Engineer
description:
Job Description
We are seeking an experienced HSE Engineer to join our Construction Supervision team in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. The successful candidate will support the delivery of major transport, road, and infrastructure utilities projects, ensuring compliance with project HSE requirements, Saudi regulations, and international best practices. This is a site-based supervision role requiring extensive experience working with engineering consultants on infrastructure projects within Saudi Arabia.
Responsibilities
- Monitor contractor compliance with project HSE requirements, specifications, and approved safety plans.
- Conduct regular site inspections, audits, and safety observations across road, utility, and infrastructure works.
- Review and monitor method statements, risk assessments, permit systems, and emergency response procedures.
- Identify unsafe acts and conditions and ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
- Support the Resident Engineer in enforcing project health, safety, and environmental requirements.
- Monitor excavation works, utility diversions, traffic management activities, lifting operations, and confined space works.
- Review contractor HSE performance and prepare daily, weekly, and monthly safety reports.
- Participate in incident investigations and verify the implementation of corrective measures.
- Coordinate with project stakeholders to promote safety awareness and continuous improvement initiatives.
- Monitor environmental compliance relating to waste management, dust control, noise mitigation, and environmental protection measures.
- Ensure compliance with Saudi regulations, client requirements, and international HSE standards.
- Conduct toolbox talks, safety briefings, and site inductions as required.
- Maintain accurate records of inspections, audits, incidents, and corrective action tracking.
Qualifications
- Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or related discipline.
- Professional HSE qualification such as NEBOSH IGC, NEBOSH Construction Certificate, IOSH, or equivalent.
- Minimum 8 to 12 years of overall experience with at least 5 years of experience in Saudi Arabia.
- Demonstrated experience on transportation, roads, highways, infrastructure, and utility projects within KSA.
- Previous experience working for engineering consultants or construction supervision consultants is essential.
- Strong knowledge of Saudi HSE regulations, infrastructure construction risks, and industry best practices.
- Experience monitoring utility works including wet and dry utilities, stormwater, drainage, potable water, irrigation, power, and telecommunications networks.
- Excellent report writing and communication skills in English.
- Ability to engage effectively with contractors, client representatives, and project stakeholders.
- Saudi Council of Engineers registration preferred.
- Relevant professional certifications and training in construction safety will be an advantage.
- Candidates must have a dominant background in KSA infrastructure supervision projects and consultant-side delivery.
- Candidates with primary experience in building projects, contractor-only environments, design offices, or corporate HSE roles are not preferred.
Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.
Work with us and be part of a team shaping the future of infrastructure and sustainable communities across Saudi Arabia and beyond.

title: Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) Engineer
location: Al Murooj, Al Jawf, Saudi Arabia
description:
Job Description Summary
Job Description:
Role Purpose
The HSE Engineer / HSE Representative is responsible for supporting the implementation and monitoring of Health, Safety and Environmental (HSE) requirements across AAR project sites in Sakaka, Dumat Al Jandal, and Miguwa within the Al Jouf Region of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
The role is accountable for hazard identification, risk prevention, site safety inspections, high-risk activity monitoring, contractor compliance, emergency preparedness, incident reporting, corrective actions, and HSE documentation, in accordance with applicable Saudi regulations, approved project procedures, and contractual requirements.
Working closely with the Project Director, Project Manager, contractors, subcontractors, and site supervision teams, the HSE Engineer supports safe project delivery by monitoring compliance, escalating serious hazards, and exercising Stop Work Authority within the approved project authority matrix.
Specific Duties
HSE Compliance & Risk Management
- Implement and monitor the Project HSE Plan and applicable Saudi HSE and Civil Defense requirements.
- Review Risk Assessments, Method Statements, and JSA/JHA, and ensure adequate control measures are established before work starts.
- Conduct regular site inspections to identify unsafe acts, unsafe conditions, and HSE non-conformities.
- Track corrective actions and verify their effective closure.
- Escalate serious or repeated HSE violations to Project Management immediately.
High-Risk Activities, Permit-to-Work & Equipment Safety
- Monitor safe execution of the following activities, as applicable:
- Excavation, earthworks, and trenching
- Work at height, scaffolding, ladders, and MEWPs
- Lifting operations, cranes, forklifts, and rigging
- Electrical works, temporary power, and LOTO
- Hot work, welding, and cutting
- Confined-space activities
- Heavy equipment and mobile machinery
- Structural steel erection and mechanical installation
- Construction, installation, testing, and commissioning activities
- Verify that competent personnel, approved procedures, permits, equipment inspections, exclusion zones, and required safety controls are in place.
- Monitor implementation of the Permit-to-Work (PTW) system for high-risk activities, and verify permits, risk assessments, isolations, precautions, and permit closure.
- Monitor the condition and safe use of lifting equipment, machinery, power tools, and temporary installations, and verify availability of required inspection, testing, and certification records.
- Report unsafe equipment or unauthorized work and follow up corrective actions.
Fire Safety & Emergency Preparedness
- Monitor fire prevention and protection arrangements, including extinguishers, fire points, emergency exits, access routes, and assembly points.
- Monitor emergency preparedness and availability of emergency equipment.
- Participate in and support emergency drills and evacuation exercises.
- Monitor arrangements for fire, serious injury, equipment incidents, chemical spills, and other identified emergencies.
- Coordinate with project emergency personnel and authorities when required.
Occupational Health, Environment & Welfare
- Monitor workplace health risks such as heat stress, dust, noise, chemicals, ergonomics, and manual handling.
- Monitor PPE availability and proper use.
- Monitor housekeeping, access/egress, welfare facilities, and safe material storage.
- Monitor chemical storage, waste management, and spill prevention.
- Identify environmental and occupational-health deficiencies and follow up corrective measures.
Training & Safety Awareness
- Conduct or coordinate site HSE induction for workers and visitors.
- Conduct or support Toolbox Talks and safety awareness activities.
- Communicate task-specific hazards, controls, and emergency requirements.
- Maintain training, induction, and attendance records.
- Monitor required worker competency, licenses, and authorizations.
Contractor & Subcontractor HSE Control
- Monitor contractor and subcontractor compliance with Aviagen/project HSE requirements.
- Review relevant contractor HSE documentation, RAMS, JSA, and permits within the assigned scope.
- Conduct inspections of contractor work areas and activities.
- Monitor PPE, competency, training, equipment condition, and safe working practices.
- Record non-conformities and follow up corrective actions.
- Participate in HSE coordination meetings and communicate safety requirements.
- Contractors and subcontractors remain responsible for the safety of their personnel, equipment, work methods, and activities in accordance with their contractual and legal obligations.
Incident & Near-Miss Management
- Report accidents, injuries, near misses, property damage, and environmental incidents immediately.
- Secure and preserve the incident area where required.
- Collect factual information and participate in investigations.
- Assist in identifying immediate, underlying, and root causes, as applicable.
- Prepare or contribute to incident reports and corrective/preventive actions.
- Monitor action closure and communicate relevant lessons learned.
HSE Documentation & Reporting
- Prepare and maintain, as applicable:
- Daily HSE/site inspection reports, and weekly and monthly HSE reports
- HSE observation and corrective-action registers
- PTW, high-risk activity, and Risk Assessment/JSA records
- Training, induction, and Toolbox Talk records
- Equipment inspection records
- Incident, near-miss, and emergency drill records
- Contractor HSE compliance records
- Monitor agreed HSE KPIs and provide timely information to Project Management.
Authority & Accountability
- Communicate serious or imminent hazards immediately to the responsible supervisor and Project Management.
- Exercise or recommend Stop Work Authority in accordance with the approved project authority matrix.
- Require unsafe conditions to be corrected before work continues, within the limits of assigned authority, and verify that corrective measures are implemented before affected work resumes, where applicable.
- Maintain professional independence and accurate factual reporting of HSE issues.
- Escalate unresolved or repeated violations through the established project management process.
- Do not assume the statutory, medical, engineering, inspection, or contractual responsibilities of other qualified parties or contractors.
Staff Management
n/a
Financial Management
n/a
Travel
Field-based role requiring regular presence at remote project locations in Sakaka, Dumat Al Jandal, and Miguwa (Al Jouf Region); frequent travel between project sites will be required. Exposure to construction, agricultural, industrial, and infrastructure project environments, combining field inspections, safety monitoring, and office-based reporting.
Specific Experience
Personal Requirements for the role
- Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Engineering, Occupational Health & Safety, Environmental Science, or a related discipline.
- Recognized HSE certification (NEBOSH IGC or equivalent, IOSH, or OSHA) is required; First Aid and Fire Safety/Emergency Response training are desirable.
- Registration with the Saudi Council of Engineers (SCE) where applicable to the candidate's engineering qualification and title.
- Experience in construction, industrial, infrastructure, agricultural, manufacturing, or similar project environments.
- Proven experience in contractor safety management and site inspections.
- Familiarity with high-risk work activities and permit-to-work systems.
- Familiarity with applicable Saudi HSE regulations, Saudi Labour Law occupational safety requirements, and Civil Defense requirements.
- Working knowledge of Risk Assessment and JSA/JHA methodologies, incident investigation methodologies, emergency preparedness and response, and HSE inspections, audits, and reporting.
- Familiarity with ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 management system requirements is an advantage.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications; experience with digital HSE reporting and incident management tools is an advantage.
- Good communication and reporting skills in Arabic; English communication capability is advantageous.
- Experience in poultry or agricultural facility construction, including biosecurity requirements for farms, hatcheries, and feed mills, is considered a key advantage and should be identified as a preferred qualification for this role.
- Valid Saudi driving licence is an advantage, given frequent travel between remote project sites.
- Strong knowledge of Saudi Labor Law, occupational safety regulations, and applicable Civil Defense requirements.
- Valid Saudi Iqama/Work Permit with an engineering profession aligned with the position
Competencies, Skill & Attributes
- Risk & Hazard Awareness: Identifies hazards and unsafe conditions early and ensures adequate control measures are in place before work starts.
- Regulatory Compliance Focus: Applies Saudi HSE, Civil Defense, and project requirements consistently across all site activities.
- Inspection & Attention to Detail: Conducts thorough site inspections and verifies that corrective actions are effectively closed.
- Contractor & Stakeholder Management: Builds credible working relationships with contractors, subcontractors, and project teams while holding them accountable to HSE requirements.
- Communication & Influencing: Communicates hazards, controls, and expectations clearly in Arabic and English, and influences safe behavior on site.
- Emergency Response & Judgment: Responds calmly and decisively to incidents and emergencies, and escalates serious hazards without delay.
- Integrity & Independence: Maintains professional independence and reports HSE issues accurately and factually.
- Planning & Organization: Manages inspections, permits, training, and reporting across multiple remote sites and competing priorities.
- Reporting & Digital Literacy: Prepares accurate HSE records, registers, and KPI reports using Microsoft Office and digital reporting tools.

title: Traffic Engineer
description:
مهندس مرور وسلامة (Traffic & Road Safety Engineer)
القسم / الإدارة: إدارة المشاريع الهندسية / الطرق والنقل
موقع العمل: الرياض
الجنسية: سعودي (حصرًا)
سنوات الخبرة: 5 سنوات فأكثر
الهدف العام من الوظيفة
تخطيط وتنفيذ ومراقبة معايير هندسة المرور والسلامة المرورية في مشاريع الطرق والبنية التحتية، وضمان تطبيق الاشتراطات والمواصفات المعتمدة من وزارة البلديات والإسكان (أو وزارة النقل والخدمات اللوجستية) والأمانات، وإعداد ومراجعة خطط التحويلات المرورية ودراسات التأثير المروري (TIA) لضمان انسيابية وأمان الحركة أثناء تنفيذ المشاريع وبعد تشغيلها.
المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية
- إعداد واعتماد خطط التحويلات المرورية (TMP): تصميم ومراجعة واعتماد خطط التحويلات والسلامة المرورية لمواقع العمل ومطابقتها لأدلة العمل المعتمدة من الأمانة/الوزارة والإدارة العامة للمرور.
- إدارة السلامة في مناطق العمل: الإشراف الميداني على تجهيزات مناطق العمل (العلامات التحذيرية، اللوحات الإرشادية، الحواجز الخرسانية والمطاطية، الدهانات، وأجهزة التنبيه الضوئية) والتأكد من صيانتها الدورية.
- التفتيش والتدقيق الدوري: إجراء الجولات الميدانية والتدقيق على السلامة المرورية (Road Safety Audit)، وتوثيق الملاحظات والمخالفات وإلزام المقاولين/فرق التنفيذ بتصحيحها فورًا.
- تحليل الحوادث والمخاطر: التحقيق الفني في الحوادث المرورية التي تقع ضمن نطاق العمل أو حرم الطريق، وتحليل مسبباتها، وتقديم الحلول الهندسية لمنع تكرارها.
- إعداد التقارير: رفع تقارير دورية وفنية عن مستويات الأداء والسلامة المرورية ومراحل إنجاز التحويلات والتراخيص لإدارة المشروع والجهة المالكة.
المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة
- المؤهل العلمي: بكالوريوس في الهندسة المدنية أو هندسة النقل والمرور من جامعة معترف بها.
- الاعتماد المهني:
- تسجيل واعتماد ساري لدى الهيئة السعودية للمهندسين (درجة مهندس محترف أو مشارك).
- اعتماد ساري كمهندس معتمد لدى الأمانة أو الوزارة (أمانة المنطقة أو وزارة البلديات والإسكان / وزارة النقل).
- الخبرة العملية:
- خبرة لا تقل عن 5 سنوات في مجال هندسة المرور والسلامة على الطرق.
- خبرة عملية مثبتة في مشاريع الأمانات، البلديات، أو مشاريع وزارة النقل.

title: Quality Control Engineer

This is a Quality Assurance and Quality Control (QA/QC) position responsible for overseeing quality management systems, contract compliance, inspections, testing activities, and adherence to real estate development standards across residential projects. The role requires strong technical expertise in building construction and real estate development, leadership in quality systems implementation, and the ability to effectively coordinate with contractors, consultants, suppliers, and project stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery.
Your role
- Understands the requirements of construction contracts, specifications, Requests for Proposal (RFP), and Tender Documents related to building and high-rise construction projects.
- Prepares clear and concise quality reports, inspection reports, audit findings, non-conformance reports (NCRs), corrective action reports (CARs), and technical correspondence.
- Monitors QA/QC aspects of civil, structural, architectural, and MEP construction activities to ensure compliance with project specifications, approved shop drawings, codes, and standards.
- Reviews and evaluates contractor and subcontractor Quality Management Systems (QMS), Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), Method Statements, and Quality Control Procedures.
- Conducts surveillance inspections and audits to verify compliance with project requirements, ISO standards, and approved quality procedures.
- Reviews material submittals, technical data sheets, samples, mock-ups, and supplier qualifications for compliance with project specifications.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer – Product Certification & Approvals
Company: Saudi Pipes Systems Co. (SPS)
Location: Jeddah, Saudi Arabia
Employment Type: Full-Time
JOB PURPOSE
Saudi Pipes Systems Co. (SPS) is seeking an experienced Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer to manage and maintain our quality management systems, product certifications, and regulatory approvals across our manufacturing operations.
The successful candidate will take direct responsibility for Saudi Aramco approvals, ISO 9001, NSF, WRAS, and other applicable product certifications, ensuring ongoing compliance, successful audits, timely renewals, and uninterrupted approval status.
This is a hands-on QA and certification management position, not primarily a QC inspection or construction-site quality role.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
• Product Certifications: Manage, maintain, and renew NSF, WRAS, and other applicable product certifications, including coordination with certification bodies and testing laboratories.
• Saudi Aramco Approvals: Handle Saudi Aramco product and manufacturer approvals, technical submissions, documentation, audits, and ongoing compliance requirements.
• Quality Management Systems: Maintain and improve the company’s ISO 9001 QMS, including procedures, records, internal audits, and external certification audits.
• Regulatory Compliance: Manage applicable SASO/SABER requirements and support FM Approvals where relevant.
• Technical Documentation: Prepare and maintain technical files, product specifications, laboratory test reports, compliance records, and certification documentation.
• Audit Management: Coordinate external certification audits, factory assessments, surveillance audits, and renewal activities.
• Corrective Actions: Manage non-conformities, root cause analysis (RCA), corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), and audit findings.
• Cross-Functional Coordination: Work closely with production, QC, engineering, and management to maintain product compliance and certification readiness.
REQUIREMENTS & QUALIFICATIONS
• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Chemical, Materials, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
• Minimum 4–6 years of relevant QA experience, preferably in pipe, valve, water infrastructure, or industrial manufacturing.
• Proven hands-on experience managing product certifications, external audits, approvals, and renewals.
• Strong knowledge of ISO 9001 quality management systems and documentation.
• Practical experience with Saudi Aramco approvals, NSF, WRAS, SASO, or similar certification schemes.
• Ability to independently manage certification processes and communicate directly with certification bodies and regulatory authorities.
• Strong English communication and technical documentation skills.
• ISO 9001 Lead Auditor certification is an advantage.
• Preference for candidates currently residing in Saudi Arabia with a transferable Iqama.
IMPORTANT
Applicants should have direct experience in manufacturing QA, product approvals, or certification management. Experience limited to construction-site QC inspection will not be sufficient.
Apply through LinkedIn with your updated CV, highlighting the certifications and approvals you have personally managed.
